viewer: Retirees and savers buying 5-year CDs through a brokerage account for money they will not need for years.
decision: Take the 5-year CD paying 4.5% that the bank can call early, or the 4% CD it cannot call?
promise: We replay decades of interest rates to see how often the bank would have called the CD and what the saver ended up earning.
title: Callable CD at 4.5% or a Locked 4%? We Replayed History
thumbnail: Bank vault door with a hook pulling back a CD certificate / "Called Early?"
